title: Mixing: Wings Over America by Wings | 1976
content:
Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Phil McDonald, Mark Vigars, Tom Walsh

Wings continued mixing the live album Wings Over America on 3 November 1976.

On this day, the third of 13 mixing sessions, the songs ‘Venus And Mars’ and ‘Jet’ were worked on. Both had been recorded on 27 May 1976 at the Riverfront Coliseum in Cincinnati.
